**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment (correct for a clause that benefits us).

What changed in the repair: the substance of the finding stands, but the rationale now explicitly disposes of the two failed deterministic checks rather than leaving them unaddressed. Both checks — duration ≤ 12 months and presence of a general-solicitation carve-out — presuppose an existing non-solicit covenant to measure against. Since no such covenant binds Northwind Analytics, there is no duration or carve-out to test, so those failures are artifacts of an inapplicable test rather than evidence of a deviation. Section 12.3's general-recruitment language also supplies the substance of a carve-out independently.

I also widened the verification trail on this pass, reading § 16.1–16.5 in full to rule out a personnel restraint tucked into Confidentiality, in addition to § 30 and § 12. All clean.

Position reached: **preferred** (no non-solicit on Customer), not fallback. § 12.4's restraint on Vendor remains noted as out of scope to avoid double-flagging a term that runs in our favour.
